title: Use Aveva API tote management to exchange a tote by tote ID or lane number
summary: Manually trigger a tote exchange using the Aveva API tote management page, either by specifying a tote ID (Exchange Tote) or by specifying a lane number (Exchange Lane). The lane-number format requires adding a leading zero (example: 3050 -> 03050).
when_to_use: Use when you need to manually trigger a tote exchange to remove/correct a tote state in the system using the Aveva API tote management functions: “Exchange Tote” (by tote Id) or “Exchange Lane” (by lane number with a leading zero).
not_for: Do not use this procedure if the system issue is not related to tote exchange (the source frames this as a way to remove a tote from the system / correct tote state).
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the manual tote exchange via the Aveva API tote management page and confirm the page returns an acceptance/confirmation output.
access_or_tools_needed: Aveva API page for tote management (API Features for Tote Management)
Tote Id or lane number (lane number requires adding a zero per the source example)

access_required: Access to the Aveva API tote management page (API Features for Tote Management)
system_preconditions: You have the correct tote Id or the correct lane number to exchange.

visual_references.description: Frame showing the Aveva API page “API Features for Tote Management” including “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane” and related tote-management functions.
Frame showing “API Features for Tote Management” with “Exchange Tote — Manually trigger a tote exchange by tote Id” and “Exchange Lane — Manually trigger a tote exchange by lane number”.

steps.title: Open the Aveva API tote management page (API Features for Tote Management)
steps.purpose: Access the manual tote exchange controls (“Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane”) needed to trigger the exchange.
steps.instruction: Open the Aveva API page for tote management that contains the “API Features for Tote Management” section with the “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane” functions.
steps.expected_result: The Aveva API tote management page is visible and shows the “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane” controls under “API Features for Tote Management”.
steps.healthy_condition: The page displays the tote-management feature list including “Exchange Tote” (manual exchange by tote Id) and “Exchange Lane” (manual exchange by lane number).
steps.failure_condition: The page does not show the “Exchange Tote” / “Exchange Lane” controls or the page cannot be accessed.

actions.label: Open tote management API page
actions.exact_action: Open the Aveva API page for tote management (API Features for Tote Management).

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot access the Aveva API tote management page or cannot locate the “Exchange Tote” / “Exchange Lane” controls, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/API features list includes “Exchange Tote — Manually trigger a tote exchange by tote Id” and “Exchange Lane — Manually trigger a tote exchange by lane number”.
Transcript: “...you can exchange a tote so and you can like any tote on the system, you can manually exchange.”

steps.title: Exchange a specific tote using “Exchange Tote” (by tote Id)
steps.purpose: Trigger a manual tote exchange for a specific tote Id.
steps.instruction: On the Aveva API tote management page, use the “Exchange Tote” function and provide the tote Id.
steps.expected_result: A manual tote exchange is triggered for the specified tote Id via the “Exchange Tote” function.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Exchange Tote” function is used with a tote Id value (tote Id corresponds to the tote you intend to exchange).
steps.failure_condition: The exchange cannot be triggered (no acceptance/confirmation output is returned).

actions.label: Trigger Exchange Tote by tote Id
actions.exact_action: Use “Exchange Tote” — “Manually trigger a tote exchange by tote Id” and provide the tote Id.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the exchange cannot be triggered or the API does not return an acceptance/confirmation, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: “Exchange Tote — Manually trigger a tote exchange by tote Id.”

steps.title: Exchange by lane using “Exchange Lane” (lane number with leading zero)
steps.purpose: Trigger a manual tote exchange for a lane when you do not want to target by tote Id.
steps.instruction: On the Aveva API tote management page, use the “Exchange Lane” function and provide the lane number, adding a leading zero to the lane number format (example given: 3050 -> 03050).
steps.expected_result: A manual tote exchange is triggered for the specified lane number via the “Exchange Lane” function using the leading-zero lane format.
steps.healthy_condition: The lane number you enter matches the required leading-zero format (example: “3050” is entered as “03050”).
steps.failure_condition: The exchange cannot be triggered or the API does not return an acceptance/confirmation output.

actions.label: Trigger Exchange Lane by lane number
actions.exact_action: Use “Exchange Lane” — “Manually trigger a tote exchange by lane number” and enter the lane number with a leading zero (example: 3050 -> 03050).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the exchange cannot be triggered or the API does not return an acceptance/confirmation, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: “Exchange Lane — Manually trigger a tote exchange by lane number.”
Transcript: “...do it by lane name, which you have to add a zero... I’ll start with 3000... so it’s zero 3050.”

steps.title: Submit/execute the exchange action from the API page
steps.purpose: Actually send the manual exchange request from the Aveva API tote management page.
steps.instruction: Execute/submit the exchange action from the Aveva API tote management page after entering the tote Id (Exchange Tote) or lane number (Exchange Lane).
steps.expected_result: The exchange request is submitted from the API page.
steps.healthy_condition: The exchange action is executed from the API page (request is sent).
steps.failure_condition: No request is sent or the API does not proceed to return output/confirmation.

actions.label: Execute exchange request
actions.exact_action: Submit/execute the exchange action from the Aveva API tote management page.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the exchange cannot be triggered or the API does not return an acceptance/confirmation, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “...you can exchange a tote so and you can like any tote on the system, you can manually exchange.”

steps.title: Verify the exchange request was accepted (API page response/output)
steps.purpose: Confirm the manual exchange request was accepted by the system.
steps.instruction: Observe the Aveva API tote management page output/response area for the exchange action and confirm it returns acceptance/confirmation.
steps.expected_result: The API page shows an acceptance/confirmation output for the exchange action.
steps.healthy_condition: The exchange action produces a visible acceptance/confirmation output on the API page.
steps.failure_condition: The API page does not return acceptance/confirmation for the exchange action.

actions.label: Check API response/confirmation
actions.exact_action: Observe the API page response/output for the exchange action and confirm acceptance/confirmation.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the exchange cannot be triggered or the API does not return an acceptance/confirmation, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate expected/failure notes: verify acceptance/confirmation output on the API page; stop and escalate if not returned.

success_criteria: A manual tote exchange is triggered for the specified tote Id via “Exchange Tote”, or for the specified lane number (with leading zero) via “Exchange Lane”.
The Aveva API tote management page returns acceptance/confirmation output for the exchange action.
healthy_conditions: The Aveva API tote management page shows the “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane” functions under “API Features for Tote Management”.
The lane number is entered with the required leading-zero format (example: 3050 -> 03050).
The exchange action produces visible acceptance/confirmation output on the API page.
failure_conditions: Exchange cannot be triggered from the Aveva API tote management page.
The API does not return acceptance/confirmation output for the exchange action.
Lane number formatting is incorrect (lane number not entered with leading zero as required by the source example).
escalation_guidance: If the exchange cannot be triggered or the API does not return acceptance/confirmation, stop and escalate to support.
